description: The 100 issues opened in the Polars repository in the first half of March 2025, from GitHub's search API: when each was closed, or that it is still open. Statistics idea: survival analysis with censoring. An issue still open is censored: it lasted at least this long. The Kaplan–Meier estimator (with Greenwood's 95% band) gives the share still open after t days, for all issues and for bugs against enhancements, and its median is compared with the median of the closed issues only, which is biased low. Caveats: one repository and two weeks; 'closed' includes 'not planned'; unauthenticated GitHub search allows 10 requests a minute.
name: How long issues stay open
